long_description: The DREAME L10s Ultra Gen 3 is a powerful robot vacuum and mop with 25,000 Pa suction and 5 suction levels for thorough cleaning on hard floors and carpets. The self-cleaning all-in-one docking station handles maintenance, and control is convenient via app or voice. Ideal for anyone who wants to save time in daily life and keep their home effortlessly clean — from the premium brand DREAME.
